findings.what: pages-6.spec.ts fails on the integration branch, so the required check `npm run e2e` is red. The test 'the three pages load no tool script' requires a footer on every built route except 404.html. P6-A5 merged the /embed/* routes in 32d38d9, which is not an ancestor of the agent's last commit 647e641. Those routes render no footer, which the plan allows (5.10: 'the footer is not required there'). This is a merge conflict in meaning between the two branches, and MERGE did not catch it.
findings.evidence: npx playwright test -c <scratch>/pw.config.ts (port 7160) site/tests/e2e/pages-6.spec.ts -> '1) pages-6.spec.ts:217:3 > the three pages load no tool script: Error: embed/affine/ renders the footer'; 1 failed, 21 passed. The same failure under BASE_PATH=/sub/path/ (basepath + pages-6: 73 passed, 1 failed). `git merge-base --is-ancestor 32d38d9 647e641` -> not ancestor. A scan of site/dist finds 14 routes without data-site-footer, all embed/*.
findings.specRef: plan 5.10 (embed routes need no footer); CLAUDE.md Rules (merge when every required check is green); SPEC 7.7
findings.proposedFix: In the loop over discoverRoutes(), skip routes that start with 'embed/' (or assert that they have no site footer), and keep the no-script check for every footer that exists.

findings.what: The history page states a false fact about [W20]: 'Near its end it states the Mutation Conjecture'. SOURCES 11.1 puts the conjecture in section 2, on p. 57 of a paper that runs from p. 55 to p. 78, so it is near the start.
findings.evidence: Built /history/ text: 'Near its end it states the Mutation Conjecture, which has a page of its own on this site.' SOURCES.md:28: '2 The Mutation Game on a Directed Graph (the Mars story; ...; the Mutation Conjecture, unnumbered, p. 57)'. SPEC 2.11: '[W20] (p. 57, unnumbered) states'. The citation on the same page reads 'pages 55 to 78'.
findings.proposedFix: Say 'In its section 2 (p. 57) it states the Mutation Conjecture', or drop the locator.

findings.what: The page credits Donnelly with proving strong convergence ('The paper proves strong convergence in this convention (Theorem 2.1)'). SOURCES lists [Don08] Theorem 2.1 only as '(strong convergence)'. SPEC F3 says the theorem is attributed to Mozes and Eriksson, and the page itself credits Eriksson for strong convergence.
findings.evidence: SOURCES.md:142 'Theorem 2.1 (strong convergence)'. SPEC.md:260 'the theorem is attributed to Mozes and Eriksson [S2]; [Don08] Theorem 2.1 [S]'.
findings.proposedFix: 'The paper states strong convergence in this convention (Theorem 2.1), a theorem attributed to Mozes and Eriksson.'

findings.what: In a release build the credits page says something false and drops the asset fields 7.9 asks for. Its sentence 'It links the videos below, from the history page and the sources page' stays, but /history/ links no video in release because the E5 fallback replaces the links. All four video entries then read 'Title: a video lecture whose title is still being checked. Author: still being checked. Source: still being checked.' Meanwhile /sources/ still links the same four videos by title in release.
findings.evidence: RELEASE=1 OUT_DIR=<scratch>/dist-release npm run build. grep youtube in dist-release: history=0, credits=0, sources=4 links. The credits text in release shows the sentence above and four identical fallback entries.
findings.specRef: SPEC 7.9 bullet 4; 7.3 (a fallback must stay true); Appendix E item 5
findings.proposedFix: Word the sentence so it holds in both builds, for example 'It links the videos below; until they are checked, only the sources page carries the links'. Settle the E5 question for /sources/ (already with the owner) so that credits and sources agree in release.

findings.what: The oracle section overstates and miscounts the outside checks. It says 'Two outside works served as checks on those data: SageMath was run to confirm the Cartan matrices of the boards of finite type'. SOURCES shows that Sage confirmed the four reference matrices (B2, C2, G2, F4) and the node numbering. It also shows that the Satake catalogue was checked against [DM22] and several other papers as well as dynkin-diagrams.
findings.evidence: SOURCES.md:264 lists the four CartanMatrix outputs. SOURCES.md:215: checked 'against a paper that states every diagram in words [DM22]; against the Satake codes in ... dynkin-diagrams ...'. SOURCES.md:244 'Other sources used to check the catalogue'.
findings.proposedFix: 'Outside works also served as checks: SageMath was run to confirm the reference Cartan matrices and the node numbering, and the Satake catalogue was compared with [DM22] and with the codes in dynkin-diagrams ...'

findings.what: The page states CoReLG's licence as fact without a wrapper. CoReLG appears among 'Reference software under the GPL or LGPL', but Appendix F marks its licence [U] and Appendix E item 17 names 'the licence of CoReLG'. The plan (5.9 item 6) says to wrap that statement as E17 or leave it out. The sentence is P1-A4's restatement of SPEC 7.9 bullet 3, so the conflict comes from SPEC itself.
findings.evidence: SPEC.md:2398 'CoReLG (GAP) ... GPL [U for the licence]'. SPEC.md:2375 (E17): 'the licence of CoReLG'. Built /credits/: 'Reference software under the GPL or LGPL (SageMath, CoReLG, ...)'.
findings.specRef: SPEC 0.2 item 5, Appendix E item 17, plan 5.9 item 6
findings.proposedFix: Reword without stating CoReLG's licence (for example 'Reference software such as SageMath, CoReLG, ... , some of it under the GPL or LGPL, is used only ...'), or flag the conflict to the owner.

findings.what: The footer and credits tests do not catch typed or missing values. The test accepts data-commit='unknown', so a footer that drops the commit survives (MU3). The typed-licence check reads only the markup after the frontmatter, so `const code = 'AGPL-3.0-only'` and a typed content licence in the frontmatter pass. The same holds for credits.mdx, which only checks that the rendered identifiers match the files.
findings.evidence: MU3 (every data-commit rewritten to 'unknown') -> 'footer shows the versions and the commit' passed. node <scratch>/footer-src-mutant.mjs Footer.astro -> 'mutant: version-typed check fails=false; licence-typed-in-markup check fails=false'.
findings.specRef: plan 5.10 and trap 'Licences are read, not typed'; SPEC 7.4 Citing
findings.proposedFix: When .git exists, require data-commit to be a prefix of HEAD or an ancestor of it. Search the whole Footer.astro and credits.mdx source for SPDX-looking literals (CC-BY, AGPL, MIT, Apache).
